summary: Tuple-struct deserialization discarded the known field count and called deserialize_seq, consuming payload bytes as a varint length although tuple-struct serialization writes no length prefix. The fix calls deserialize_tuple(len, visitor), preserving field alignment. Blocked: no detecting upstream test exists at this revision. The fix adds no tests; de::test::structs and tests/loopback.rs use TupleStruct((u8, u16)), a single-field newtype that invokes deserialize_newtype_struct and then deserialize_tuple, bypassing the affected method.
